Name: Standalone Crane Game
Author: rokugin
Description:
[size=5][u]Install[/u][/size][size=3]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Unzip the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.
(optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0.

[/size][size=5][u]About[/u][/size][size=3]
During a discussion on the modding Discord, I realized I'd never actually played the crane game because the few times I'd actually gone into the movie theater, the guy was hogging it. Decided I'd like to be able to play it whenever I felt like but couldn't find an up to date mod that did that so I made this one.

[/size][size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size][size=3]
Shouldn't have any incompatibilities.
[/size]
[size=3]Special thanks to focustense for their help with figuring out how to make it so my code worked properly, especially with controllers. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25257]Check out their mod[/url] if you're using a controller! [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25257]

[/url][size=3][url=https://github.com/rokugin/StandaloneCraneGame]Source[/url][/size]
